questions.question: What is composition?
questions.answer: Composition is a strong 'has-a' relationship where contained objects cannot exist independently of the container.

questions.question: What is starvation in synchronization?
questions.answer: Starvation occurs when a process waits indefinitely because resources are repeatedly allocated to other processes.

questions.question: What is the First Normal Form (1NF)?
questions.answer: A relation is in 1NF if all attributes contain atomic values and there are no repeating groups.
